name: Motto Nee, Chanto Shiyou yo!
original_name: もっと 姉、ちゃんとしようよっ！
source:
Souma goes to an all-boys school by himself in Hokkaido. One day, he received a call from one of his older sisters, telling him that their father had become sick and collapsed. He quickly returns to Hakkakubashi and seeing his five downcast sisters and sickly father, he decided to stay to take care of his father.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
飒马独自在北海道的一所男校就读。一天，他接到一位姐姐的电话，得知父亲生病倒下。他立刻赶回八角桥，看到五位神情低落的姐姐和病弱的父亲后，决定留下照顾父亲。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
